description: Daily Brief V2 handoff packet. Splits user-facing render_payload from internal governance_metadata so governance never renders into the brief body. Prompt 02 enriches the record-bearing sections with real, source-linked record detail where a working reader exists (calendar, email threads, Procore action signals) and enforces the count-vs-detail rule: a count is only actionable if backed by listed records, otherwise the section must declare detail_available=false + a detail_gap_reason. Procore record domains without a dedicated reader emit the explicit detail-unavailable shape (never a bare count).
count_vs_detail_rule: If the brief reports a count it must either list the underlying records with useful detail or explicitly say record-level detail is unavailable. A bare count is never actionable content. A count of 0 needs no records (nothing to report).

detail_policy.valid_section: count==0 (nothing to report); OR records present AND detail_available=true AND count==len(records); OR positive count with no records AND detail_available=false AND a non-empty detail_gap_reason.
detail_policy.truncation: When more records exist than are listed, set truncated=true and total_count to the full count (no silent caps).
detail_policy.missing_field_policy: Fields not persisted by repo truth (e.g. responsible-party/vendor NAMES) are emitted null with a per-record detail_availability reason; opaque ids are carried separately where available; days_open/age derives only from a real start timestamp else null + reason. Never fabricate.

global_requirements: render_payload carries user-facing, brief-ready data only.
governance_metadata is never rendered into the brief body.
no governance key (packet_id/hash, source coverage, guardrails, proof/receipt metadata) appears inside render_payload.
source refs are emitted as hashes + safe labels only (no raw refs, bodies, tokens, or URLs).
every count-bearing section obeys the count-vs-detail rule: listed records or an explicit detail-unavailable reason.
record details remain source-linked (every record carries source_family + source_ref_hash).
no raw calendar/email/source payload (no body, raw subject, email address, Graph/join/signed URL, token, or header).
review-required, stale, and low-confidence flags are preserved on renderable items.
read-only; metadata-only; persists nothing; fail-closed on missing contract or raw leakage.

cli.build: hb-assistant second-brain daily-brief packet --date YYYY-MM-DD --version v2 --json
